name.value: Poco Inn & Suites Hotel & Conference Centre

description.value: A 99-room full-service hotel in Port Coquitlam, about 30 minutes from downtown Vancouver, with East and West wing rooms ranging from standard queens to themed suites and a kitchen suite. The hotel offers a dining restaurant, room service, lounge, and a fitness centre with sauna on-site. A past testimonial from the Tour de Fox Pacific Northwest charity cycling ride confirms the property has hosted touring cyclists.

raw_osm.name: Poco Inn & Suites Hotel & Conference Centre

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms an operational 99-room full-service hotel in Port Coquitlam. Wi-Fi is explicitly confirmed ('high speed wired and Wi-Fi in every room'). No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, drying areas, or any other cycling-specific amenities anywhere on the site; a testimonial from the 'Tour de Fox Pacific Northwest ride' confirms cyclists have stayed here but adds no amenity detail. Phone and website match OSM; address is consistent with the 'heart of Port Coquitlam' description but not printed verbatim on the fetched pages.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational, publicly bookable hotel with an active website and confirmed rooms — straightforward include regardless of unconfirmed cycling-specific amenities.
